title: Ecommerce Admin API request reference
scope: All registered /api routes; PUT/PATCH aliases share an entry. Web/admin HTML routes are outside this reference.

conventions.required: required, optional, conditional or prohibited; nested requirements apply to each supplied parent object/array entry.
conventions.fields: Request fields only: path/query/body, with headers listed separately. Asterisk means each array element; items.*.quantity means items[0].quantity, etc.
conventions.types: Numeric rules may accept numeric strings. Dates/enums use string type. Files require multipart/form-data.
conventions.restrictions: validation_rules retain Laravel syntax; notes explain dynamic and cross-field restrictions. Tenant records must belong to the selected tenant.
conventions.base_url: Resolved with Laravel Boost; replace origin for another environment, keeping /api paths.
conventions.pagination: page is a query field. per_page is configurable only where documented.
conventions.updates: PATCH does not automatically make all fields optional. Follow each endpoint field list.
conventions.responses: Request reference, not response schemas. State/authorization checks can reject otherwise valid input.
conventions.validation_rules: Laravel validation notation, supplemented with documented conditional/business checks. Braced IDs in constraints refer to the current route/body ID. These strings are documentation, not executable validation rules.
